text:
Planes fly because of the shape of their wings… unbelievable, right?! Air moves faster over the top of the wing—and slower underneath! This creates a difference in pressure… and that, my friend, generates lift!

Lift is the upward force that fights gravity—yes, fights it! Gravity pulls the plane down… but as long as lift is stronger, the plane rises, soaring into the sky!

The engines roar with thrust, pushing the plane forward—forward, faster, unstoppable! This forward motion keeps air flowing over the wings… keeping lift steady… keeping the plane alive in the air!

By balancing lift, thrust, gravity, and drag—pilots control this magnificent dance! That’s how planes stay up… gliding, cutting through clouds… safely, brilliantly, through the endless sky!
